title: Italian-Style Sirloin Steak with Crumbly Topping
description: A classic Italian-inspired dish featuring a juicy sirloin steak topped with a crumbly Mexican-inspired topping.
instructions: Season the sirloin steak with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer to the oven.
Cook the steak to desired doneness, about 8-12 minutes total.
While the steak cooks, mix the crumbly mexican cheese, parsley, and garlic in a bowl.
Remove the steak from the oven and top with the cheese mixture.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
